info.title: Kufr device backend API
info.description: Device authentication and exactly two continuous production conversation engines: GPT-Live and Realtime 2.1. Conversation contract version 2 advertises versioned configured capabilities, ordered audio transport, private revisioned images and manual-only memory archives. Retired standalone/scripted entry points return an explicit 410 upgrade requirement. The backend returns validated data and never commands physical actuators. Sensitive responses use Cache-Control: no-store.

get.description: Exact base64 payload authenticated by DER ECDSA P-256/SHA-256. Channel authority is service-provisioned; a device token is not needed. Invalid releases return 404. Shared distribution limit: four concurrent responses, no queue.

200.description: Signed envelope, at most 8192 bytes

429.description: Concurrent distribution limit reached; retry with backoff

200.description: SHA-256 verified image; authenticate signed metadata before use

post.summary: Attach an explicitly consented revisioned JPEG to the current conversation
post.description: JPEG at most 262144 bytes, decoded dimensions 1..640, stripped of EXIF/GPS/thumbnails. Existing correlation headers bind the current device, boot, conversation, generation and catalog. Image-Id, Image-Source, Captured-At and Image-Revision identify the attachment; a higher explicit revision permits retake/replacement during an active session. Image-Consent:true permits consent granted after voice starts. Missing revision is bounded older-client attachment compatibility; it does not restore any retired conversational engine. Duplicate idempotency keys never repeat analysis. Late analyses publish only if conversation and visual revision are still current. Vision failure leaves voice usable; analysis has its own bounded slot. Active metadata is conversation-scoped; archival JPEG/description remain private and manual-only until explicitly deleted. Phone/browser and suitcase sources remain distinguishable; this route does not prove camera hardware availability or authorize appearance roast.

202.description: Poll image operation; same-key replay never causes another provider call.

delete.summary: Revoke or supersede the active visual revision while preserving voice and archive

204.description: Active cue revoked; stale revocation cannot clear a replacement. Retained engines receive the effective empty/replaced visual context. Previously consumed material cannot be unsaid. This does not delete archived content or require voice shutdown.

delete.description: Revocation invalidates provider visual context and pending spoken output, emits audio_cancel with a monotonically increasing responseGeneration, and keeps the application voice session open. Clients flush queued PCM and reject older generations; archived media remains until explicit manual deletion.

put.summary: Correct or discard the current conversation visual cue
put.description: No provider call. Explicit description is at most 240 characters without control characters; empty text clears the active cue and returns an empty manual receipt. A correction may occur during voice and increments the visual revision. Manual correction wins over pending analyses; late photo work cannot restore a cleared cue. At most eight corrections per conversation. This active cue is conversation-scoped, not a global personality setting. Existing archive content is manual-only; explicit scoped deletion is separate.

post.description: Continuous primary gpt-live-1 autonomous session with delegated application decisions through the configured Sol/Luna decision service. Maximum 180 seconds; speed must be 1. Provider credential readiness is independent of retired dialog/voice flags. Persona, current guest binding, history and source-fenced memory are shared application state. Incremental timed transcripts survive interruption; Stop/deletion/rebinding fence obsolete tasks. Input is continuous audio including overlap with output. Use authenticated WebSocket audio-stream for phone input; bounded /audio remains the ordered firmware transport for this same engine. pause cancels obsolete audible output. playback_checkpoint requires /playback after actual local drain; /played acknowledges terminal output. /availability invalidates stale physical snapshots. No replay or direct actuation. Usage reservations are audit accounting, never local monetary caps. Old scripted actor configuration requires migration; no scripted production engine remains.

200.description: Continuous NDJSON GptLiveEvent; at most 20 MB, individual lines below 64 KiB.

post.description: PCM16 mono 24 kHz, 2 to 9600 even bytes, at most 1440000 bytes per turn. Input-Sequence starts at zero. One upload in flight; never retry ambiguous delivery. Frames for the just-ended inputId are acknowledged and discarded. The stream, conversation and authenticated device must match.

204.description: Frame accepted once or discarded after VAD stop

post.summary: Acknowledge actual completion of native audio playback
post.description: A body of at most 512 bytes identifies the exact completed operation. Duplicate acknowledgements are harmless. The next listening event can arrive before this HTTP response, so clients must reset their input state before sending. Include responseGeneration from the audio/cancellation stream; after audio_cancel a prior generation cannot complete a newer response using the same operationId.

204.description: Playback acknowledged; next turn can be reserved

post.summary: Stream a bounded hands-free conversation with automatic voice activity detection
post.description: Continuous gpt-realtime-2.1 session using the official SDK and the same application persona, guest identity, durable history, image context and validated physical-selection boundary. Fresh conversation/opening=true start; at most 4096 start bytes. Each listening event carries its inputId; ordered audio-stream frames or firmware /audio chunks bind to that input. Visitor transcript, audio, pause, completed and heartbeat events are application events. /played acknowledges the exact completed operation before the next turn. Stop, expired auth, disconnect or context deletion cancels obsolete work. No input/audio replay after unknown outcome. Retired realtime-turns is HTTP410, never a production text/PTT adapter.

Explicitly delete private archived media and invalidate active visual context

get.summary: Open one authenticated ordered input WebSocket for this engine session
get.description: Bearer device access stays in the Authorization header, never the URL. One attached WebSocket per session. Text frames at most 14000 bytes contain inputId, nonnegative sequence and base64 audio. PCM16 mono24kHz payload is 2..9600 bytes and even-sized; base64 at most12800 characters. Ack binds inputId and sequence. Auth is rechecked for each frame. A duplicate/out-of-order input, expired auth or unknown send outcome ends bounded recovery; audio is never replayed. This transport does not create another conversational engine.

101.description: WebSocket upgrade; frames follow AudioStreamFrame and AudioStreamAck schemas.

get.summary: Inspect explicit identity binding and permitted source records for one conversation
get.description: Administrator only; never a guest/public retrieval route. Bounded to50 records with totalRecords/hasMore. SourceReference is evidence provenance, not an instruction; facts, corrections, visual observations and fiction retain separate kinds. Unbound guest receives no other guest personal facts.

200.description: Private permitted context and source identity.

delete.summary: Manually delete conversation, guest or evening archive scope
delete.description: Administrator only, requires observed content epoch. Deletes raw transcripts, canonical records and associated private visual sources while preserving tombstones. Late indexing, summarization, upload and retries cannot restore deleted content; active affected provider contexts stop. Remote index deletion may remain pending. No retention sweep or permission rebinding implies this action.

200.description: Local deletion complete, remote index deletion tracked separately.

409.description: Original proposal, epoch or outcome conflicts

IdempotencyKey.description: UUID bound to device, route and request-body hash; different content with the same key returns 409. Content-free record retained for 24 hours.

AcceptedOperation.description: Existing or newly accepted asynchronous operation for the idempotency key and body

payload.description: Exact base64 JSON: schemaVersion, version, buildId, hardware, profile, channel, updaterVersion, minUpdaterVersion, url, sizeBytes, sha256 and signatureAlgorithm. Verify signature before decoding metadata.

signature.description: Base64 DER ECDSA P-256 signature over decoded payload bytes using SHA-256

CostumeContext.description: Active structured visual cue scoped to the current conversation. It expires with that conversation; archived source media has a separate manual-only lifecycle. An empty manual receipt acknowledges a clear and is never a provider cue.

visualRevision.description: Present only for a completed visual revocation barrier. A client waiting for photo revision R may unmute only after this value is at least R; an ordinary speech interruption marker cannot release that mute.

GptLiveCapability.description: Readiness describes configured provider credentials only; model access and audible device behavior require separate checks. Camera sources describe supported attachment contracts, never physical availability.

RealtimeCapability.description: Readiness describes configured provider credentials only; model access and audible device behavior require separate checks. Camera sources describe supported attachment contracts, never physical availability.

PrivateMemoryRecord.description: Private administrator-authorized source/provenance record. Kind separates user-reported facts, interpretations, visual observations, proposed/confirmed choices and pending questions. Never returned by public diagnostics.

OperationEpoch.description: Original device operation epoch as a canonical uint64 decimal string. Absent means legacy zero; retries never adopt a newer epoch.
